children: Collective Mining unexpectedly discovered a new high-grade extension of its main gold deposit in Colombia after drill holes aimed at a secondary target intercepted a new mineralized zone.

The miner on Tuesday said that the discovery occurred when two directional drill holes aimed at testing the Apollo system of its flagship Guayabales project inadvertently encountered a new high-grade, gold dominant zone of mineralization.
"The Apollo system once again awarded us with yet another positive surprise," said Executive Chairman Ari Sussman.

Collective Mining currently has 13 drill rigs operating across the entire project and said aggressive follow-up drilling is under way to expand the new northern extension, with new results expected late in the third quarter or early in the fourth.
